text:
emma: quick heads-up  we need a crisp driver/CUDA/ROCm pin for the Marketplace image bundle before signing the joint announcement. target: friday EOD for partner ok.

shaun: i'll run the compatibility matrix and the L0 perf smoke. proposing pins: nvidia-driver 536.23, cuda 13.0.0, rocm 6.3.1. these are what passed our internal perf lab yesterday.

anita: noted. partner legal asked we avoid saying 'supported on experimental kernels' in the listing. prefer: 'validated on partner-provided images' + a link to compatibility notes.

emma: agreed. can you paste the minimal matrix snippet for partner sign-off (one-liner per OS)?

shaun: paste below for quick ack:

```
ubuntu-22.04: nvidia-driver=536.23, cuda=13.0.0
ubuntu-20.04: nvidia-driver=536.23, cuda=13.0.0
centos-8: rocm=6.3.1
rocky-9: rocm=6.3.1
```

partner-bot: Reminder: partner embargo window request received 2026-04-01T09:00Z. Please supply final copy by 2026-04-02T00:00Z.

shaun: testing plan: 1) nightly regression (full suite) 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC, 2) canary on marketplace image 2026-04-02 07:00 UTC, 3) partner verification window 24h after canary. if any ROCm L1 failure, we flag and remove ROCm from listing until partner hotfix.

anita: rollback snippet for release notes draft: "If customers experience GPU driver regressions after upgrading, follow the rollback procedure in our KB: revert to previous driver bundle via `redwood images revert --id <image-id>` and contact support. Our team will open an expedited patch."

emma: nice. two editorial asks from partner: 1) shorten the announcement paragraph referencing hardware to one sentence; 2) include a short note about SI integration testing completed (date + internal ticket ref).

shaun: SI note: integration complete 2026-03-28, ticket SI-4421. adding that to the doc. also adding a bullet for post-release monitoring: token-latency SLO, driver-related error rate, and kernel-OOM alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule: canary start 2026-04-02T07:00Z, rollout gate requires: canary-green AND partner-ack.

anita: partner signoff path: i will obtain email from partner-engineering + legal sign-off. partner asked for the phrase: "Validated against partner images provided during integration testing." ok to use?

emma: ok for draft. final must go through the partner contact, but use that wording for now. shaun, once your canary is green, ping #release-war-room and cc partner-eng.

shaun: will do. final question: do we include explicit kernel versions in the marketplace doc? partner prefers we omit kernel numbers and only list OS + driver/CUDA/ROCm. thoughts?

emma: omit kernel numbers to avoid becoming a perpetual maintenance burden. mention kernel compat as "dependent on partner image" and link to compatibility notes.

anita: partner legal confirmed embargo and wording earlier. i'll attach their email to the shared doc. once shaun confirms canary-green, i'll collect JAR sign-off and we can publish.

emma: summary actions: shaun = run canary + post results, anita = partner legal + JAR, emma = finalize draft + marketplace copy. aim to publish next week pending green gates. thanks all. :tada:
